AuthorHandle.title: AuthorHandle
AuthorHandle.description: Unique case-insensitive public author name reservation stored at /authors/{authorKey}. Contains no PII.

authorKey.description: Normalized unique author identifier matching document ID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the single user who owns this author name.

authorName.description: Canonical display casing of the unique author name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the author name was claimed.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public-safe user workspace profile stored at /users/{userId}.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Unique author display name shown in the workspace and on published World notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was first created.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent sign-in.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII login metadata stored at /users/{userId}/private/info.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

providerId.description: Authentication provider identifier (e.g., google.com or password).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when login info was first recorded.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sign-in.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: A user note that can be private (owner-only) or world (publicly readable by anyone).

content.description: Plain-text body content of the note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

/authors/{authorKey}.description: Unique author handle registry ensuring only one user UID can own a given author name.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only private PII login info subcollection (docId: info).

/notes/{noteId}.description: Notes collection supporting owner-only private notes and publicly readable world notes.
